fails_if: `ErrataFieldEntry` accepts name authority records from another native variable of the same register (it compares register and provider but not the native variable id)
note: The target is variable 5 (CVID 20); the authority is variable 6 (CVID 22), which supplies the replacement name. Everything else is complete, so only the native-family rule refuses it.

message_contains: name authority must be disjoint peers in the same native family
